text:
```yaml
name: Claude PR critique

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      # Web
      - name: Install dependencies (web)
        uses: bahmutov/npm-install@v1
        with:
          working-directory: web
          useLockFile: true
          useRollingCache: true
          install-command: npm ci
          cache-key-prefix: web
      - name: Lint (web)
        working-directory: web
        run: npm run lint
      - name: Typecheck (web)
        working-directory: web
        run: npm run typecheck
      - name: Test (web)
        working-directory: web
        run: npm test

      # Apps
      - name: Install dependencies (apps)
        uses: bahmutov/npm-install@v1
        with:
          working-directory: apps
          useLockFile: true
          useRollingCache: true
          install-command: npm ci
          cache-key-prefix: apps
      - name: Lint (apps)
        working-directory: apps
        run: npm run lint
      - name: Typecheck (apps)
        working-directory: apps
        run: npm run typecheck

      # Electron
      - name: Install dependencies (electron)
        uses: bahmutov/npm-install@v1
        with:
          working-directory: electron
          useLockFile: true
          useRollingCache: true
          install-command: npm ci
          cache-key-prefix: electron
      - name: Lint (electron)
        working-directory: electron
        run: npm run lint
      - name: Typecheck (electron)
        working-directory: electron
        run: npm run typecheck
      - name: Test (electron)
        working-directory: electron
        run: npm test

      # Claude PR critique
      - name: Claude PR critique
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-base-action@beta
        with:
          prompt: |
            You are a helpful code reviewer. Please provide a short critique of the changes in this pull request, focusing on potential improvements, edge cases, and overall quality. Keep it concise (2-3 sentences).
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
```
